On top of {wiki:Vandura Mountain|Vandura Mountain}, northeast of Liberty Bay, a lone {creature:Medusa} guards her treasure. Climb the mountain among {creature:Wyrm|Wyrms} and {creature:Energy Elemental|Energy Elementals}, kill the Medusa and search the pile of bones to take 4 {item:Black Pearl|Black Pearls}.
A lone medusa guards its treasure.
Health potions and, preferably, energy protection (Wyrms and Energy Elementals)
The {creature:Medusa} can paralyse you; bring potions and do not let your health get too low.
On the way there are also {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders} and {creature:Wasp|Wasps}.

Go to {wiki:Vandura Mountain|Vandura Mountain}, **northeast** of {wiki:Liberty Bay|Liberty Bay}, and start climbing. The mountain is on the same island as Liberty Bay ({wiki:Vandura}), so you go on foot: leave the city and walk northeast to the mountain ({coord:32415,32776,7}).
Map of Vandura island, with Liberty Bay and the mountain to the northeast
You will face several {creature:Wyrm|Wyrms} and some {creature:Energy Elemental|Energy Elementals}.
Enter the cave on the 4th floor
On the **fourth floor**, enter the cave and go up the **south** ramp.
Up there is a single {creature:Medusa}. Kill her.
Search the pile of bones in the **northwest corner** of the room to receive the reward.

There is no shortcut out: go back the way you came. Go down the **south** ramp, leave the 4th floor cave and descend the mountain floor by floor to the ground. Then walk **southwest** to {wiki:Liberty Bay|Liberty Bay}.
The {creature:Wyrm|Wyrms} and {creature:Energy Elemental|Energy Elementals} may have respawned in the meantime; keep potions for the way down.
Also known as the *Black Pearls Quest*.
